newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM aluminium futures end mixed.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM aluminium futures end mixed.

text.p: Yen-based Tokyo aluminium futures ended mixed on Tuesday, as buying orders from local investors met technical sales in the afternoon, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.8 yen lower to 4.3 yen higher, with the benchmark June 1998 contract down 0.5 yen at 201.5 yen per kg. The estimated volume was 3,713 lots.
Local investors, encouraged by the dollar's rise against the yen and higher prices on the London Metal Exchange, built long positions in early Tuesday trade, traders said.
But the buying failed to last into the afternoon, and profit-taking capped the topside, they said.
In London on Monday, three-month aluminium futures closed at $1,690 per tonne, up five dollars from the previous close.
